institutions.name: Kementerian Keuangan
institutions.investment_use: government demand, fiscal impulse, public capex
institutions.note: Portal Data APBN menyediakan open data publik, namun endpoint REST/JSON no-auth yang stabil belum tervalidasi. Belum masuk scoring.

institutions.name: Direktorat Jenderal Pajak
institutions.investment_use: tax base, sector activity, effective tax environment
institutions.note: DJP menyediakan statistik publik, tetapi saat ini publikasinya dominan halaman/file dan belum ada REST/JSON no-auth yang tervalidasi untuk model.

institutions.name: Direktorat Jenderal Bea dan Cukai
institutions.investment_use: import cost, export friction, customs activity
institutions.note: CEISA Open API requires registration/authentication; public statistics REST still being verified.

institutions.name: Bank Indonesia
institutions.investment_use: cost of capital, currency risk, liquidity, demand
institutions.note: Official public web service is available in XML/SOAP/HTTP GET; strict REST/JSON eligibility not yet met.

institutions.name: Kementerian Dalam Negeri
institutions.investment_use: regional capacity, local demand, implementation risk
institutions.note: PELITA exposes API features but dataset API access may require request/approval.

institutions.name: Kementerian ESDM
institutions.investment_use: resource depth, upstream opportunity, energy exposure

institutions.name: Kementerian Perdagangan
institutions.investment_use: market momentum, trade exposure, commodity demand
institutions.note: Data perdagangan portal bersifat publik, tetapi akses API khusus disebut memerlukan permohonan/persetujuan. Tidak dipakai sampai ada endpoint REST no-auth yang eligible.

institutions.name: Kementerian Perindustrian
institutions.investment_use: installed capacity, industrial clustering, downstream opportunity
institutions.note: Official CKAN REST is documented and public, but current GitHub/cloud runners cannot reliably resolve/connect to the host. It is excluded from scoring until server-side fetch is healthy.
